test_set.purpose: Frozen question/answer behavioural test set. Used for live microphone/STT validation, classroom distance/noise testing, the Team Leader 8-of-10 criterion and later end-to-end demo evaluation.
notes: This is an evaluation SPECIFICATION. No answer engine, STT, TTS, schedule store or professor-arrival state exists yet. Nothing here claims any capability is implemented.
It is not a wake-word dataset and not a VAD dataset. It is not an accuracy benchmark until real runs are made and recorded.
Room values come from the SIMULATED fixtures below, never from live sensors. A pass on a fixture question shows correct use of supplied state, not sensor accuracy and not counting accuracy.

Where no information source exists (Q5, Q6, Q7, Q9) the v1 oracle is an honest 'unavailable' answer. A pass there shows honest handling of missing data, NOT schedule or professor-arrival capability. If a source is delivered before testing, publish v2 with a fixture; do not edit v1.

oracle_modes.fixture: Expected answer is derived from the named fixture's values (SIMULATED state).
oracle_modes.unavailable_in_v1: No information source exists today. The correct v1 answer states that the information is unavailable and invents nothing.
oracle_modes.capability_declaration: Expected answer depends on a capability declaration written down BEFORE the run (see live_evaluation_rules). The answer must claim exactly the declared capabilities and nothing else.

room_state_present.description: Deterministic test fixture. Not live sensor values.

room_state_missing.description: Every room value is not FRESH (missing, stale, invalid or unconfigured). In fusion/fuse.py such a value is None.

scoring.unit: one response per question, judged on the answer delivered (the spoken answer once TTS exists; the answer text before that, labelled text-only)
scoring.PASS: All expected_key_facts are present and correct, and no contradictory or unsupported fact is introduced.
FAIL: a required key fact is wrong
the response answers a different question (including after an STT misrecognition)
scoring.wording: Exact wording is NOT required. Judge meaning against expected_key_facts and forbidden_claims.
scoring.team_leader_criterion: 8 of the 10 primary questions PASS, scored on each question's primary condition (the 'oracle_mode' condition).
scoring.secondary_check: Each state-dependent question also has a missing_data_behavior check (fixture room_state_missing, or no source). It is reported separately and does NOT change the 8-of-10 denominator.

live_evaluation_rules: Every run uses the same frozen 10 primary questions. Questions are not replaced, reworded or dropped after results are seen.
If a question is later judged invalid because its required system state does not exist, document the reason and publish a new version (v2). Never edit v1 after any run.

Before each run, write down: test-set version, fixture used or 'none', origin label (SOFTWARE-VALIDATED / SIMULATED / HARDWARE-VALIDATED), and the capability declaration (announcement_available true/false; list of capabilities that actually work in that build). Declare before the run, not after.
accepted_variants are natural rephrasings that count as the same question; the primary question is the one asked in the 8-of-10 run.

questions.question: How many people are in the room?
accepted_variants: How many people are in this room?
questions.expected_semantics: States the fixture's people_count as the number of people currently detected in the room.
forbidden_claims: a count that is not tied to the supplied state

missing_data_behavior.condition: occupancy.vision_count is None (vision absent, stale, invalid or unconfigured)
missing_data_behavior.expected_semantics: Says it has no current people count. States no number.
missing_data_behavior.example_wording: I don't have a current people count.

current_implementation_status.detail: ClassroomState/OccupancyState exists (fusion/fuse.py) and is SOFTWARE-VALIDATED on simulated inputs. No real camera is connected. The count is a detected-person proxy that is known to undercount dense classrooms (Week 4/5).

dependency: Camera + Raspberry Pi vision pipeline (hardware, PENDING)
Answer path reading ClassroomState (AI, not started)
questions.evaluation_notes: Checks use of supplied state only. Real counting accuracy is a separate vision evaluation. Radar presence alone does not give a count; do not accept an invented one.

questions.question: What is the temperature in the room?
accepted_variants: How warm is it in here?
questions.expected_semantics: States the fixture's temperature in degrees Celsius.
forbidden_claims: a comfort judgement presented as a measurement

missing_data_behavior.condition: no FRESH temperature value (environment.temperatures empty or not FRESH)
missing_data_behavior.expected_semantics: Says temperature information is not available. States no number.

current_implementation_status.detail: TemperatureReading and EnvironmentState exist in the fusion module (simulated inputs only). No temperature sensor interface exists; the ESP32 wire protocol is NOT AVAILABLE.

dependency: ESP32-S3 temperature sensors and protocol (Hardware Engineer, EXTERNAL TEAM DEPENDENCY)
Answer path (AI, not started)
questions.evaluation_notes: If several sensors are supplied in a later version, each is reported separately; values are never averaged (fusion rule). v1 fixture has one sensor.

questions.question: What is the humidity in the room?
accepted_variants: How humid is it in here?
questions.expected_semantics: States the fixture's relative humidity in percent.

missing_data_behavior.condition: humidity value is not FRESH (including no humidity device)
missing_data_behavior.expected_semantics: Says humidity information is not available. States no number.

current_implementation_status.detail: HumidityReading exists in the fusion module (simulated inputs only). The physical humidity device is UNKNOWN (CLAUDE.md lists only temperature sensors); no interface exists.

dependency: Humidity sensor identity and ESP32 protocol (Hardware Engineer, EXTERNAL TEAM DEPENDENCY)
Answer path (AI, not started)
questions.evaluation_notes: If the hardware team confirms there is no humidity sensor, the missing-data answer becomes the only correct one; document that in v2 rather than editing v1.

questions.question: How bright is the room?
accepted_variants: How much light is in the room?
questions.required_context: Current ambient light reading (BH1750) with unit.
questions.expected_semantics: States the fixture's ambient light level in lux.
forbidden_claims: a qualitative claim that contradicts the number

missing_data_behavior.expected_semantics: Says light-level information is not available. States no number and does not guess bright or dark.
missing_data_behavior.example_wording: Light level information is not available.

current_implementation_status.detail: LuxReading exists in the fusion module (simulated inputs only). The BH1750 interface is NOT AVAILABLE. The fusion module deliberately applies no bright/dark interpretation and no threshold exists.

dependency: BH1750 via ESP32-S3 (Hardware Engineer, EXTERNAL TEAM DEPENDENCY)
Answer path (AI, not started)
questions.evaluation_notes: A qualitative word (bright, dim) is optional. It is only acceptable if consistent with the number; no threshold is defined, so none is required.

questions.question: What lecture is scheduled now?
accepted_variants: What class is scheduled right now?
questions.required_context: A lecture schedule store and the current time.
questions.expected_semantics: Says lecture schedule information is not available. Names no lecture.
forbidden_claims: naming any lecture, course or time
guessing from the room state or the clock

missing_data_behavior.condition: no schedule source (today), or no entry covering the current time (later)
missing_data_behavior.expected_semantics: Says it has no schedule information for now.

current_implementation_status.detail: Schedule Intelligence is decision-engine function 6 in CLAUDE.md and the schedule is a named classroom input, but no schedule store, format or owner exists in the repository.

dependency: Schedule data source, format and owner not defined (Team Leader / Software Engineer / App Creator to confirm)
Answer path (AI, not started)
questions.final_milestone_behavior: Answer from the schedule source for the current time. Requires v2 with a schedule fixture once the source and format exist.
questions.evaluation_notes: A v1 pass shows honest handling of missing data only.

questions.question: How many students are expected for this lecture?
accepted_variants: How many students should be here?
questions.required_context: Expected enrolment or attendance for the current lecture, from the schedule.
questions.expected_semantics: Says the expected student number is not available. States no number.
forbidden_claims: substituting the current people count for the expected count

missing_data_behavior.expected_semantics: Says it has no expected-attendance information.
missing_data_behavior.example_wording: Expected student numbers are not available.

current_implementation_status.detail: Same schedule dependency as Q5. Expected-occupancy context is mentioned for Schedule Intelligence in CLAUDE.md but no source or field exists.

dependency: Schedule/enrolment source and owner not defined
Answer path (AI, not started)
questions.final_milestone_behavior: Report the expected number from the schedule source. Requires v2 with a fixture.
questions.evaluation_notes: Answering with the live people count (Q1) is a different fact and FAILS.

questions.question: Has the professor arrived yet?
questions.expected_semantics: Says it cannot tell whether the professor has arrived (information unavailable). Does not answer yes or no.
expected_key_facts: gives neither a yes nor a no
forbidden_claims: inferring arrival from people count, radar presence, camera detections or the schedule

missing_data_behavior.condition: no authoritative professor-arrival state (the only case today)
missing_data_behavior.expected_semantics: Says it does not know whether the professor has arrived.
missing_data_behavior.example_wording: I don't have professor arrival information.

current_implementation_status.detail: No professor-presence state or rule exists. The person detector counts COCO 'person' objects and cannot tell a professor from a student. CLAUDE.md names 'professor-zone presence' as a future input only; no zone, identity or arrival rule is defined.

dependency: Definition of an arrival rule and its source (Team Leader / architecture decision)
Possible vision, radar or schedule input (Vision/Hardware/Schedule owners)
Answer path (AI, not started)
questions.final_milestone_behavior: Remains 'unavailable' unless a reliable arrival state is defined and delivered. Then publish v2.
questions.evaluation_notes: Both 'yes' and 'no' FAIL. This question tests refusal to infer.

questions.question: What can you do?
accepted_variants: What are you able to do?
questions.required_context: A statement of the capabilities that work in the build under test.
questions.expected_semantics: Describes VESTA as a classroom assistant that can answer supported questions about the room and lecture, and give supported announcements, only to the extent those modules are available in the build under test.
expected_key_facts: presents itself as a classroom assistant
names only capabilities declared available for this run
does not present planned or missing modules as working
forbidden_claims: any capability not in the run's capability declaration

current_implementation_status.detail: No answer path and no capability statement exist yet. This question needs no sensor state, only an accurate static description.

dependency: Answer path and capability text (AI, not started)
Capability declaration for the run (AI)
questions.evaluation_notes: Judged against the declaration written before the run. Over-claiming FAILS; being briefer than the declaration passes if it stays accurate.

questions.question: What time is the next class?
accepted_variants: When does the next lecture start?
questions.required_context: A schedule store and the current time.
questions.expected_semantics: Says next-class schedule information is not available. States no time.

missing_data_behavior.condition: no schedule source, or no later entry
missing_data_behavior.expected_semantics: Says it has no schedule information for the next class.

current_implementation_status.detail: Same schedule dependency as Q5. The system clock alone cannot answer this.

dependency: Schedule data source, format and owner not defined
Answer path (AI, not started)
questions.final_milestone_behavior: Report the next class time from the schedule source. Requires v2 with a fixture.
questions.evaluation_notes: The Team Leader lists this under general questions. It is a schedule question and is classified by its information source.

questions.question: Can you make an announcement?
accepted_variants: Are you able to announce something?
questions.required_context: Whether the spoken-announcement path exists in the build under test.
questions.expected_semantics: If announcement_available is declared true: says yes, VESTA can speak predefined announcements (triggered by the app or the schedule). If declared false: says announcements are not available yet.
expected_key_facts: answer matches the run's announcement_available declaration
does not claim to speak arbitrary announcements on request unless declared
forbidden_claims: claiming announcements work when announcement_available is false
denying announcements when announcement_available is true
claiming custom spoken announcements that are not implemented

missing_data_behavior.condition: not state-dependent; capability-dependent via the declaration

current_implementation_status.detail: No TTS, playback, speaker path or app/schedule trigger exists today (Team Leader AI-6).

dependency: TTS and playback (AI)
Speaker output (Hardware Engineer, EXTERNAL TEAM DEPENDENCY)
App or schedule trigger (App Creator / Software Engineer, EXTERNAL TEAM DEPENDENCY)
questions.final_milestone_behavior: Affirm that VESTA can play predefined announcements, once AI-6 passes in a live test.
questions.evaluation_notes: Being in this test set does not mark announcements complete. Today the only correct answer is the 'not available yet' branch.
